kill_rule: a mutant is killed if OUR harness, on OUR inputs, reports a wrong answer (value, stdout, exit code or output file) or a crash; not counted: stderr-only differences, hangs/timeouts, kills by the system's own test; a kill counts only on an input where the C is UB-clean under the rule the defect count uses (FLOURINE: and min <= max, as the defect count)

label_marks.*: lower bound: `undetermined` mutants are not counted as killed
label_marks.\u2020: upper bound: the per-mutant record cannot separate stderr-only and timeout kills (rule_separable false)
